title: Optimizing Diagnostics Of Syncope Events Using Intelligent Telemetric Solutions.
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess efficacy of prolonged Full Disclosure electrocardiogram (ECG) monitoring and signal analysis using advanced telemetric technology to diagnose syncope in comparison with standard diagnostic procedure
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* History of syncope
* Ability to operate the telemetric device at home
* Exclusion of underlying neurological disease
* informed consent undersigned by the parents
* informed consent undersigned by the child if over 16 years of age

Exclusion Criteria:

* Syncope with known underlying disease
* Inability to operate the telemetric device at home
* Complete Heart block
* QT\>500ms
* Implantation of ICD
* Inability to comply with the study protocol
